title: Let the controller turn the thread tools off for one Anthropic turn
text: A chat turn request may now carry threadTools: false, which is the controller's answer that this turn has no thread tools. The Anthropic chat adapter in apps/controller/src/providers/anthropic/chat.ts asks its threadTools source for a server to mint for each turn. When the request says false, it must not ask the source at all, even when one is wired, so no token is minted and no server starts. The turn then launches exactly as a turn without a source does: the MCP configuration passed to the client is the strict empty one (--strict-mcp-config with an object that has no servers) and no thread tool is added to the allowed tools, so no argument names a crewkite MCP tool. A request that leaves the field unset or true keeps today's behavior and still gets the minted server. Apply the same rule to the Google and OpenAI adapters, and in the Local and OpenAI adapters remove the line from the prompt that names the thread tools when a turn has none.
